parsed.title: THE QUEEN IS ALIVE
parsed.body:
RESOLVE
IN A CORRIDOR

Activate the Queen.
If not possible – place her
in the Corridor.

Place the
number of
Intruders
shown on the
token (Adults
and Drones) in
the Corridor.

Place 1 Larva
in the Corridor.

RESOLVE
IN A ROOM

Activate the Queen.
If not possible – place her
in the Room.

Place 1 Intruder
of the type shown
on the token
in the Room.

BAG
DEVELOPMENT

Activate the Queen.
If not possible – add 2 Larva
tokens to the bag.

Add 2 Queen tokens
to the bag.

Add 2 random Drone
tokens to the bag.

Add 2 random Adult tokens
to the bag. Add this token back
to the bag.
